text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Satsuki Sho, and I'm
waiting for
Nakayama Festa at the
academy gate.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see the Oka Sho?! The
favorite was
so incredible!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
She's got the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe
in her
sights too, right? She might just
be able to do it!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A and B
text_block_list.text: Aaah, the Classics are just sooo exciting!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
No surprise, the academy is abuzz with
the Classic
races beginning.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, it's cause I'm the target of
curiosity. No
way they're considering me
a favorite.
choice_data_list: There's an interview request for y...
There was an interview request for...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I may be getting interview requests, but
it doesn't
mean people are excited to
see me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nakayama!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Jordan?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Why are you registered to race in the
Satsuki
Sho?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You told me you didn't have any goals!
So what
are you doing in the Triple
Crown tour?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Why?! Tell me why?! Why does
everybody do
this?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I may get to run in the Classics, but
there are
others who can't.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm reminded of something that
happened during
training in February
this year.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ack!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, Jordan? Oh my god, your
toe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City—an Umamusume who also works as a
model—rushes over to Tosen
Jordan. She lets out
a gasp after seeing
what's transpired.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm fine... but more importantly...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
There's no way you're fine! You're
bleeding
through your shoe!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking you to the infirmary. Come on,
climb
on my back!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: N-no... I don't wanna go! I'm not going!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Don't be stupid! Come here, we should
hurry!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I said no! If I do... then...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: The doctor will tell me I can't race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running in the Classic Triple Crown is a

once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For that reason, many Umamusume even
go so far
as to stake their entire careers
for a chance at
winning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It must be like seeing your dream

shattered—gone forever.
choice_data_list: (If she gets injured at a time lik...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Other runners are staking the rest of
their lives on
the Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But I'm not gonna just hand over the win.
I can't
lose this either.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I made a promise with Teach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa arrives at the
racecourse's
waiting room and takes a
deep breath.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Inhale...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Right.
choice_data_list: Let's go prove what you're capable of.
Let's go prove what you're capable of.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Okay, time to win this bet.
